summary: Iter48 — Tested Item 5 (Admin User View / PII lookup) backend + frontend AND Phase A (central company-name + home tagline). Backend pytest 19/19 PASS after I fixed one wiring bug in server.py: the new routes/pii_admin.py router was imported but never included via api_router.include_router(pii_admin_router), so every /api/admin/pii/* endpoint returned 404. After adding one line and restarting backend, all PII flows work: GET /permission (super=true, admin initially false), GET /grants (super-only, lists admins + purposes), POST /grant + revoke cycle (admin's /permission flips), GET /nda (returns company_name + body[] + acknowledgement), POST /lookup happy path (returns profile+entitlements+decisions_count+recent_decisions+audit_id), negatives: nda_ack=false→400, purpose='Other' with empty note→400, wrong WhatsApp→404 AND still audited with matched=false, regular-user→403, admin-without-grant→403; GET /my-access-log lists own (success+failure rows), GET /access-log super-only (admin→403), and DELETE/PUT/PATCH /access-log all return 404/405 confirming append-only immutability. Phase A: GET /api/appearance includes company_name (default 'HOORECON IT-Sys Pvt Ltd'); PUT /api/admin/company-name super-only happy path + reflected in /appearance + reset; admin@test.com→403. Frontend (1280x800 desktop preview): Home page top-left header now shows the tagline 'Joyful Executive's Life Choices Operating System — Powered by AI' (NOT 'by HOORECON…'); marketing footer shows 'HOORECON IT-Sys Pvt Ltd' + © line. /admin sign-in as super_admin lands on Admin Dashboard which exposes a 'User Lookup (PII)' tile + 'Appearance · Font' tile. /admin/user-lookup renders all three tabs (Lookup, My Access Log, Manage), the PII Access NDA & terms link, purpose chips, email/WhatsApp inputs, acknowledge checkbox and View user details button — no crash, no console errors related to it. Manage tab lists all admin accounts with toggles and shows the All PII access log with both matched (green eye) and unmatched (red ×) audit rows generated by the pytest run. /admin/appearance shows the 'Company / Legal Name' editor (editable, Save button) plus the 8-font picker with Inter pre-selected. No expo/react-native deprecated packages or red-screen errors detected. Only console noise: pre-existing 'shadow*' / 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings and a non-fatal 'getRehydratedState' TypeError that exists on /auth/login and is unrelated to Item 5 / Phase A.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_iter48_pii_admin.py covers all PII admin + company-name endpoints. The fix in this iter was a single missing api_router.include_router call in server.py:206 — if a future iteration drops that line, every /api/admin/pii/* will return 404 again. The default DEFAULT_COMPANY constant lives in routes/app_appearance.py:20.
rca_of_issue: Bug: All /api/admin/pii/* routes returned 404 before the fix. Root cause: routes/pii_admin.py was imported in server.py line 121 (`from routes.pii_admin import router as pii_admin_router`) but the corresponding `api_router.include_router(pii_admin_router)` line was missing from the mount section — so FastAPI never registered any path under /api/admin/pii. Fix: inserted `api_router.include_router(pii_admin_router)` immediately after the appearance_router include (server.py line 206). Reproduction before fix: `curl -i $URL/api/admin/pii/permission` → HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found ('Not Found'). After fix: 401 without bearer, 200 with super-admin bearer.
